project_type: Static HTML template collection (HyperFrame engine contract)
test_framework: Manual validation - check HTML structure, CSS variables, manifest schema
test_command: find templates/ -name 'manifest.json' | wc -l && find templates/ -name 'layout-1x1.html' | wc -l
verification_instructions: 1. Count template directories (should be 50). 2. Verify each has manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/, thumb.png, BUILD-NOTES.md. 3. Check no JavaScript in any HTML file. 4. Verify CSS variables use only semantic tokens. 5. Verify registry.json lists all 50.
snapshot_or_generated_files: templates/registry.json - generated after all 50 templates are built
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure static HTML/CSS files
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no CDN access, no remote fonts, no external images. All assets must be local. Cannot fetch reference images from pixy.art. All templates are 'inferred' from descriptions.
contribution_requirements: Follow HyperFrame static image engine contract: no JS, no CDN, fixed 1080x1080, data-slot for editable values, data-role and data-importance on text nodes, data-visibility for toggles, only semantic CSS variables
key_patterns: Each template is a self-contained package in templates/<slug>/ with manifest.json, layout-1x1.html, assets/, thumb.png, BUILD-NOTES.md. CSS uses only: --surface, --surfaceAlt, --textPrimary, --textSecondary, --accent, --onAccent, --accentAlt, --textOverImage, --scrim-strong, --scrim-weak, --font-display, --font-body
directory_structure: templates/<slug>/ - each template package. STATUS.json at root tracks progress.
